guidance.say: Put the used mug (`mug`) from the flat top (`cooktop`) inside the nearby cart labeled USED DISHES (`dish_cart`). Then return to `cooktop`, pick up the heavy stone mortar (`mortar`) from its left side, immediately left of where the mug was, and set it on the adjacent dry equipment table (`storage_table`), not the finished-dish table (`service_table`).

The heat zone is clear. At the prep table (`prep_table`), pick up the vegetable knife (`knife`), cut the whole broccolini (`broccolini`) and whole red onion (`onion`), then return `knife` to `prep_table`.
Both vegetables are cut and the knife is back. Take the clean frying pan (`pan`) from the separate pan table (`pan_table`), place `pan` squarely on the flat top (`cooktop`), and turn on `cooktop`.
Move the cut broccolini (`cut_broccolini`) from `prep_table` onto the cooking surface of the frying pan (`pan`) on `cooktop`. Use a surface placement, and leave it there once it is resting on `pan`.

Now move the sliced onion (`sliced_onion`) from `prep_table` onto the cooking surface of `pan` beside the broccolini. Then take the spatula (`spatula`) from the dry equipment table (`storage_table`), stir `pan` with `spatula`, and return `spatula` to `storage_table`.

Cook the two cut vegetable items individually: use `[Cook] <cut_broccolini> (1)` first and `[Cook] <sliced_onion> (1)` second. Do not use the flat top or pan as the Cook target. Once they become the browned stir-fry, turn off `cooktop`.

Pick up the finished stir-fry (`stir_fry`) from the pan on `cooktop`, carry it to the dry equipment table (`storage_table`), and put it on the clean plate (`plate`). Then carry `plate` to the finished-dish table (`service_table`) and set it there.
